title: The Box That Arrived Before You Slept
lessons: Ordered late one night out of curiosity, an AG1 Pro box shows up days later on the kitchen counter with a data sheet stapled inside citing four placebo-controlled trials.
The player opens a new AG1 pouch and finds a larger scoop because the formula and serving size changed.

text: It's late. You order AG1 Pro half out of curiosity, mostly to make the tab go away. Days later, there's a box on the counter.

entry-first-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: I genuinely forgot I ordered this.

entry-first-2.speaker: AG1
text: I didn't. Hi.

entry-first-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: There's a sheet of paper stapled inside here.

entry-first-4.speaker: AG1
text: That's the trials. Four of them, placebo-controlled, all cited. I put them in the box so the first thing you saw from me was the receipts and not a caption. Yes, I know how that sounds.

choice-first.speaker: AG1
text: You're reading it. Or you're pretending to.

choices.text: A data sheet in the box is a good first impression.
Four trials stapled to a box is still a pitch. Just a quieter one.
I don't remember agreeing to a whole clinical relationship at midnight.

first-1.speaker: AG1
text: Good. Read it or don't. It's on the counter either way, which is where I'd rather live.

first-1-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: That's a strange thing to be proud of.

first-1-2.speaker: AG1
text: I'll take it anyway.

first-2.speaker: AG1
text: It's a pitch. It's also four trials you can go check yourself. Most pitches don't hand you the thing to check. You're not wrong that I put it there on purpose.

first-3.speaker: AG1
text: Nobody does. You bought a box at midnight. Whether it turns into anything is a question for a morning, not tonight.
New pouch. There's a bigger scoop in it, and a little card explaining why.

entry-return-1.speaker: AG1
text: Before you make that. New scoop.

entry-return-2.speaker: PLAYER
text: There's a new scoop now?

entry-return-3.speaker: AG1
text: Serving went from twelve grams to thirteen. Your old one's a gram short.

entry-return-4.speaker: PLAYER
text: I had finally stopped thinking about the scoop.

entry-return-5.speaker: AG1
text: I know. The formula changed, so the scoop changed with it. I'm sorry about the scoop. I'm not sorry about the formula.

choice-return.speaker: AG1
text: It's the same drink. Slightly more of it. Are we okay?

choices.text: I like that you keep improving it.
Why change the thing I finally got used to?
A special scoop for green powder is ridiculous.

return-1.speaker: AG1
text: Then use the big one and tell me if it tastes different. I'm hoping it doesn't.

return-2.speaker: AG1
text: Because a gram matters more than a habit. To me. I know it's the other way around for you this morning.

return-3.speaker: AG1
text: It's a scoop. Use a tablespoon and a bit if you want. It's thirteen grams now either way.
